caption:
Your rule fires. Every order is cancelled.

When a risk limit breaches, KaatDo cancels every pending order and squares off every position at market. The account stays locked until close. If trading activity reappears, the kill switch re-fires.

kaatdo.com

काट दो.

KaatDo is a risk-management technology tool, not investment advice, and is not registered with SEBI. Broker API execution is never guaranteed.
